overview_description.description: Inscribe offers a way for fintech and financial services organizations to automate their manual reviews, reduce fraud losses, and increase decision accuracy. By automating document reviews and improving fraud detection, companies can increase efficiency and reduce operational costs. Founded in 2017, Inscribe is trusted by leading companies like BlueVine, Petal, Fair, and Ramp. With investors from Y Combinator, Uncork Capital, Crosslink Capital, and Foundry Group, Inscribe has a global footprint with locations in North America and Europe.

about_short_description.short_description: Inscribe helps finance organizations manage risks by enabling them to detect fraud, automate processes, and understand creditworthiness.

product.name: AI Fraud Analyst
product.description: An AI-powered tool that automates document fraud detection by analyzing submitted documents and applicant details to identify fraud risks and streamline manual reviews.

product.name: AI Risk Agents
product.description: AI-driven automation tools that handle manual fraud, credit, and compliance tasks to reduce manual review workload and accelerate decision-making in financial risk management.

product.name: Loan Underwriting Automation
product.description: A solution that automates the review and analysis of borrower documents to detect fraud and assess creditworthiness during the loan underwriting process.

product.name: Risk Intelligence Software
product.description: Software that provides AI-powered fraud and credit insights to improve risk assessment and decision-making in financial services.

product.name: Document Parsing and Automation
product.description: Technology that extracts and classifies data from financial documents to support underwriting, fraud detection, and credit analysis.
